metadata.study: Slate item 4 — player health cards in the FA shopping list
metadata.method: Measured availability = max(0, 1 - days/364), days = sum of committed days_in_season across the player's 2025-26 stints in curated fact_il_stints (Cycle 9 denominator, 2 x 182 days). Delivered-WAR expectation = headline Steamer WAR x availability used + the Cycle 56 residual-bias term at delivered volume (hitters: PA x availability x (0.2617 x +0.0008 + 0.2778 x -0.0078) x 0.1132; pitchers: -0.078 x (IP x availability / 9) x 0.0837). Availability used = the player's own measured factor where one exists, else the UNC-2 pool mean for his group (hitters 0.912, pitchers 0.807). Per-player intervals are NOT derived: a pool-draw interval would present pool variance as player risk, so intervals stay scenario-level only (Cycle 56). Risk flag = measured availability below the UNC-2 pool p25 for the group (hitters 0.890, pitchers 0.629). Evidence lane from the dominant injury by keyword only; unclassified injuries link to the evidence page top. Prices stay prior-contract anchors (Cycle 61 left them untouched); delivered WAR per $10M is arithmetic on the same anchor price.
